definitions.gloss: without exception; all; entirely; every single one
definitions.explanation: Indicates that something applies to every member of a group with no exceptions.

examples.japanese: お{菓子|かし}を{残|のこ}らず{食|た}べてしまった。
examples.english: I ate all the snacks without leaving any.

examples.japanese: {参加者|さんかしゃ}は{残|のこ}らず{集|あつ}まった。
examples.english: All the participants gathered without exception.

examples.japanese: {書類|しょるい}を{残|のこ}らず{確認|かくにん}した。
examples.english: I checked all the documents without missing any.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{残|のこ}る (to remain) + ず (negative suffix)
Literal: "without remaining" → "leaving none behind"

USAGE:
Often used with verbs of collection, consumption, or checking to emphasize completeness.

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
・{全部|ぜんぶ} - all (neutral)
・{全|すべ}て - all, everything
・{一人残|ひとりのこ}らず - everyone without exception
・ことごとく - each and every one (literary)
